To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Y2O 3 :Eu 3+ nanoparticles were prepared by combustion synthesis at low temperature and short reaction time and the luminescent properties of the nanoparticles were studied.
Y2O 3 :Eu3+ nano phosphors were prepared by combustion method at lower temperature and in shorter time.
Y2O2:Eu3+ nano-phosphors were synthesized at low temperatures (350-700°C) and short reaction time (30 min) through combustion method.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of Y2O2:Eu3+ phosphor by combustion method and their cathodoluminescence, thermoluminescence, and photoluminescence.
the synthesis of Y2O2:Eu3+ nanoparticle by controlled combustion synthesis and the investigation of its cathodoluminescence (CL), thermoluminescence (TL) and photoluminescence (PL) properties.
the synthesis and characterization of the Y2O3 nanophosphors with high photoluminescent intensity and good thermal stability.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the combustion method is a simple, rapid, and cost effective method for the fabrication of nano-Y2O3: Eu3+ phosphors.
the Y2O3 nanoparticles doped by Eu3+ have been successfully synthesized by combustion synthesis method at low temperature.
Y2O 3: Eu 3+ nanoparticles are suitable for the applications of cathodo-, thermo-, photoluminescence, and radiation detectors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Y2O 3:Eu3 + nanophosphors can be successfully synthesized by combustion reaction at low temperature and short reaction time.

the combustion synthesis is a promising technique for producing luminescent materials with high luminescent intensity, and the Y2O3 nanophosphors are potential materials for application in the field of optoelectronic devices.
Y2O 3 :Eu 3+ nanoparticles are a promising material for applications in luminescence devices and thermoluminescent dosimetry.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the luminescent properties of the Y2O3 nanoparticles can be tailored by changing their size and shape and by controlling the annealing temperature and the Eu concentration.
the Y2O3 nanoparticles are promising candidates for applications as luminescent materials.
Y2O 3 : Eu3+ nanoparticles are suitable for the application as cathodoluminescent, thermoluminescent, and photoluminescence materials.
